# A background run records its process, so a wait ends when the run is gone. The record is there while the run works, and the process of the record is the run.
! exec beehave run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star &
waitfile started
exists $TMPDIR/beehave-e2e-runs

exec beehave cancel 7
wait

-- hang --
plan
-- verdicts --
approve
